say:1:1536019001:1.text: The body can fall ill, and so can the mind. Yet while healers are praised for healing the body, those who try to heal the spirit are mocked as frauds.
say:1:1536019001:1.source_cn: 人的身体会生病，精神自然也会生病。但人们只肯定治疗身体...

say:2:1536019002:1.text: Think about it. Everyone accepts that a healer can diagnose illness from a patient's symptoms; that's common sense.
say:2:1536019002:1.source_cn: 譬如：身体的医师能通过病人的症状，判断出基本的病情，这...

say:3:1536019003:1.text: But when I say I can read a person's mind from how they're described, people laugh and call me a charlatan.
say:3:1536019003:1.source_cn: 但当我告诉他们，我能够通过对某人的描述，继而分析出此人...

say:4:1536019004:1.text: So tell me, traveler who's lingered here so long, do you think the same?
say:4:1536019004:1.source_cn: 驻足许久的外乡人，告诉我，你也是这么认为的吗？
say:4:1536019004:1.male: So tell me, traveler who's lingered here so long, do you think the same?
say:4:1536019004:1.female: So tell me, traveler who's lingered here so long, do you think the same?

choice_prompt:5:1536019004.text: So tell me, traveler who's lingered here so long, do you think the same?
choice_prompt:5:1536019004.source_cn: 驻足许久的外乡人，告诉我，你也是这么认为的吗？
choice_prompt:5:1536019004.male: So tell me, traveler who's lingered here so long, do you think the same?
choice_prompt:5:1536019004.female: So tell me, traveler who's lingered here so long, do you think the same?

say:6:1536019005:1.text: That's fine. I understand. If you ever change your mind, come back.
say:6:1536019005:1.source_cn: 无妨，我能理解。等你感兴趣时，可以再来找我。
say:6:1536019005:1.male: That's fine. I understand. If you ever change your mind, come back.
say:6:1536019005:1.female: That's fine. I understand. If you ever change your mind, come back.

say:8:1536019006:1.text: Thank you for your trust. On this long, lonely night, your understanding means more than you know.
say:8:1536019006:1.source_cn: 感谢你的认可。行于漫漫孤寂的长夜，你的理解对我来说很重要。
say:8:1536019006:1.male: Thank you for your trust. On this long, lonely night, your understanding means more than you know.
say:8:1536019006:1.female: Thank you for your trust. On this long, lonely night, your understanding means more than you know.

say:9:1536019007:1.text: As thanks, I'll give you <style="highlight">three chances</style>. Describe someone to me, and I'll offer an evaluation and a piece of advice.
say:9:1536019007:1.male: As thanks, I'll give you <style="highlight">three chances</style>. Describe someone to me, and I'll offer an evaluation and a piece of advice.
say:9:1536019007:1.female: As thanks, I'll give you <style="highlight">three chances</style>. Describe someone to me, and I'll offer an evaluation and a piece of advice.

say:10:1536019008:1.text: Think of those around you. Whose mind intrigues you most?
say:10:1536019008:1.source_cn: 想想你身边认识的人，你对谁的心理比较感兴趣呢？
say:10:1536019008:1.male: Think of those around you. Whose mind intrigues you most?
say:10:1536019008:1.female: Think of those around you. Whose mind intrigues you most?

say:11:1536019009:0.text: When you're ready, seek me out.
say:11:1536019009:0.source_cn: 等你做好决定，就来这里找我吧。
say:11:1536019009:0.male: When you're ready, seek me out.
say:11:1536019009:0.female: When you're ready, seek me out.
